remarks: Prime Downtown Mid City location with shopping, restaurants, and nightlife just steps away. This recently updated, well-maintained townhouse features hardwood floors throughout and an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the dining area to a family room with a fireplace. The eat-in kitchen offers ample storage and a breakfast bar, with sliders leading to a private deck. A sunroom/office overlooks the quiet courtyard-perfect for working from home. The primary suite includes a jetted tub, while the second bedroom has its own full bath. Abundant closet and storage space throughout. Covered carport with additional storage, plus a second reserved parking space. Well-managed complex with a quiet atmosphere. The perfect blend of downtown convenience and peaceful living in a move-in-ready home that offers comfort and lifestyle in one of Stamford's most desirable locations.
